UI_Sandevistan_Opt_TogglePanel: Show / hide the floating implant panel (unassigned by default)
UI_Sandevistan_Opt_VerboseLog_tooltip: Writes everything the mod does to the console (console.txt): state, puppets, firmware and startup. When off, the console only shows warnings and errors.
UI_Sandevistan_Opt_DebugFull_tooltip: Adds the internal tests to the debug menu: full test, performance, firmware, world and audit tours. When off, only the REPORT and the effect and state tests remain.
UI_Sandevistan_Opt_LessFlashes_tooltip: Cyberpsychosis and Neural Load effects stop flickering: the screen glitch has no strips and happens at most once per second, hallucinations dissolve with a fade and danger marks do not blink. The symptoms still happen.
UI_Sandevistan_Opt_Afterimages: Afterimages while moving with the implant active
UI_Sandevistan_Opt_AfterimagesRainbow: Rainbow afterimages (instead of the variant color)
UI_Sandevistan_Opt_SlowZombieVoices: Lower zombie voices during time dilation
UI_Sandevistan_Opt_ViewportAuto: With Project Viewport in 3D: hide the 2D afterimages and marks (automatic detection)
UI_Sandevistan_Opt_HudMoodles: Also list implant statuses in the floating panel (when moodles are active)
UI_Sandevistan_Opt_SpineModel: Show the 3D implant model on the back (experimental)
UI_trait_SandevistanSpecialDesc: Something in your nervous system fits the chrome better than most. +1 Sandevistan adaptation level (never above the variant cap) and 25 percent more adaptation XP.
UI_trait_SandevistanChromeDesc: Your body treats implants as invaders: rejection builds up 50 percent faster.
UI_trait_SandevistanLabKitDesc: You start with a Prototype 05 implant, an applicator harness, a homemade immunosuppressant pack (3 doses), two suture needles and alcohol wipes. Install it yourself... or find a ripperdoc.
UI_trait_SandevistanRipperdocDesc: You spent years handing tools to a back-alley ripperdoc: you already know the synthetic compound, the homemade immunosuppressant and the herbal tincture recipes. You start with the First Aid and Electrical books (vol. 1).
UI_trait_SandevistanPsychoDesc: Max-Tac already has a file on you. Neural Load builds up 25 percent faster.
UI_trait_SandevistanEdgerunnerDesc: Live fast. While the Sandevistan is on you move 10 percent faster and hit 15 percent harder than your tier gives... but Heat builds up 25 percent faster and thermal cutoffs and collapses cost 50 percent more rejection.
UI_trait_SandevistanExCorpoDesc: You still remember the corporate formulas: you know the Black Lace recipe from day one and start with a homemade Black Lace.
UI_trait_SandevistanUnstableDesc: The chrome never quite stops humming in your head. Neural Load decays 30 percent slower while you rest.
UI_trait_SandevistanChromedDesc: You start with a lab Sandevistan already installed (1.1× wear, rejection 15), 24 hours of homemade immunosuppressant running, a 3-dose pack and the field guide. It cannot be combined with the Backstreet Installer.
UI_Sandevistan_Opt_NeuralMonitor: Cyberpsychosis: neural monitor warnings on screen
UI_Sandevistan_Opt_InstallScene: Show the installation animation when a Sandevistan is installed in you
